description: This Java source file defines the 'ContainerConfig' class, which manages container configurations in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving configurations, parsing XML elements for container properties, and handling configuration properties. The class maintains a global store of configurations and supports nested properties within container configuration elements.

classes.name: ContainerConfig
classes.description: A utility class that manages container configurations, allowing retrieval and parsing of container configuration data from XML elements.

classes.name: ContainerConfig.Configuration
classes.description: Represents a container configuration loaded from XML, with properties such as name, class, loaders, and nested properties.

classes.name: ContainerConfig.Configuration.Property
classes.description: Represents individual property elements inside a container configuration, supporting nested properties and value matching.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a container configuration by name; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getConfigurations
methods.description: Parses a root XML element to find all 'container' child elements and creates configuration objects.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name with different default types (String, int, boolean) from a PropertyChildren object.
